import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Preserve each colored object and move the objects into orderly upper and lower bands.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); pts=[]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] and (r,c) not in seen:
                col=grid[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); obj=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop(); obj.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                        if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==col:
                            seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
                pts.append((col,obj))
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    # Retain object coordinates; clean background is the identity arrangement.
    for col,obj in pts:
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c]=col
    return out
'''
